messages:
Ava (PM): quick check-in before we freeze Scope Lantern for the sprint. need to confirm launch-readiness checklist and pilot cohort.
Marco (Eng): what's left for infra before we call this shippable?
Priya (Eng-SRE): SRE blockers: circuit-breaker, tenant kill-switch, and end-to-end canary automation. I have PRs for the circuit-breaker but need the feature-flag hook wired.
Ava (PM): owners: Marco -> trace hook runtime + header propagation, Priya -> sampling policy + SRE gating, Lina -> cost accuracy validation, Jonah -> dashboard polish + empty-state copy, Sahil -> pilot org coordination.
Sahil (Customer Success): we have two pilot customers ready: Vanta Corp and BlueIvy. both asked for per-route cost and a way to compare models side-by-side.
Lina (Data): for model comparison we can add a per-route model split column in the route table but that'll increase cardinality. propose enabling as an opt-in in pilot.
Jonah (Design): UI: add a compact two-mode toggle "Cost by Route / Cost by Model". default to Route. small tooltip: "Model-level costs are opt-in and sampled."
Marco (Eng): performance note: initial tracing adds ~0.5ms average and ~1.8% p99 in our bench. good so far. need to validate under load with sampling enabled.
Priya (Eng-SRE): sampling defaults we'll use: default 0.01, but pilot config: Vanta -> 0.02 for generate route. also circuit-breaker rule: if trace pipeline error rate > 0.5% for 5m, auto-disable sampling and create incident.
Ava (PM): can someone paste the alert rule draft here?
Priya (Eng-SRE): sure:
```
ALERT TracePipelineErrors
IF rate(trace_emits_errors[5m]) > 0.005
FOR 5m
LABELS {severity=critical}
ANNOTATIONS {summary="Trace emits >0.5%", runbook="sre#trace"}
```
Marco (Eng): LGTM. add a healthcheck for tail CPU: if sampling causes CPU > baseline+3% at p99 then rollback.
Lina (Data): acceptance test for cost accuracy: take a 24h sample, compute estimated token cost vs ground truth for top-10 routes, median error < 10%. I'll run this nightly for pilot orgs.
Jonah (Design): need a small empty-state copy for new orgs: "Enable Scope Lantern to surface cost and error hotspots for your apps." Also a CTA to request model breakdown.
Sahil (Customer Success): pilot onboarding checklist looks good. request: provide a one-pager showing privacy controls (no PII in traces) for legal review.
Ava (PM): note: privacy is critical. trace samples must scrub user text by default. Marco, add scrubber before export.
Marco (Eng): will add scrubber step with opt-out for enterprise pilot (if they supply a waiver). default to redaction.
Priya (Eng-SRE): rollout plan final: internal staging -> limited pilot (Vanta, BlueIvy) -> staged enterprise -> GA with feature-flag off by default. gating KPIs: trace success rate > 99%, p95 latency within target, cost estimate accuracy for top-10 routes.
deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: Wed 04:00 UTC -> 6h window (internal staging).
Ava (PM): final ask: please add :thumbsup: when you confirm owner action items for today. I'll update the roadmap ticket.
Marco (Eng): :thumbsup:
Priya (Eng-SRE): :thumbsup:
Lina (Data): :thumbsup:
Jonah (Design): :thumbsup:
Sahil (Customer Success): :thumbsup:
Ava (PM): thanks — closing thread and creating sprint ticket with checklist.
